Title: Automatic effects Confirmation needed (Flesh of Marble)

Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

If there is an automatic effect that should trigger, can you please confirm that there is a window to use non automatic effect first?

Here is an example.
My plays Flesh of Marble, then recieve 1 damage during the current round of combat.
When they recieve more damage, is there a window to activate prevent effects before Flesh of Marble automaticly prevent all that damage.

Relevant card text:
[]uFlesh of Marble:[/u]
This combat, if a damage is successfully inflicted on this vampire in a given round, any additional damage inflicted on this vampire in the same round is automatically prevented. Aggravated damage cannot be prevented this way.

Thanks in advance,

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
> Rémi wrote:
> Dear all,
> If there is an automatic effect that should trigger, can you please confirm that there is a window to use non automatic effect first?
>
In a given round, when you receive X damage in the strike resolution (not counting additional strikes), you can choose which damage you prevent or how. The damage during a strike resolution is dealt all at the same time. I am not sure what the confusion is here, its not a timing issue. As long as you take 1 damage from SOMEwhere, flesh of marble prevents the rest. However, you must take that one damage for the card to do anything.

As a more literal example: Assume opponent has superior Carrion crows, you have superior of flesh of marble, opponent does hand strike for 3 aggravated. You now have 2 normal and 3 aggravated to deal with. You choose to take 1 normal from carrion crows, and all the rest is prevented. If opponent does additional strikes, they are also all prevented.

If instead you have superior flesh of marble and flak jacket, and opponent strikes for 2 normal and 3 aggravated, nothing really changes. You dont even need flak jacket here. You can just take the same 1 normal and prevent the rest. I am not sure why would you ever want to prevent damage specifically with the jacket if you can avoid it.

If you have superior flesh of marble and flak jacket, opponent strikes for 1 aggravated, you can choose to prevent the 1 aggro with the jacket. If opponent instead strikes for 2+ aggravated only, then you are cooked. There is no way to avoid taking the 1 aggro.

If you are looking for ways to use flesh of marble and not die to aggravated damage, skin of night, adaptability or repair the undead flesh are useful.

A classic combo is the use of zip gun, which does damage to you as well as the opponent. But this is damage you can choose to take with flesh of marble and prevent whatever opponent does.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Rémi wrote:
> Dear all,
>
> If there is an automatic effect that should trigger, can you please confirm that there is a window to use non automatic effect first?
>
*nitpicking on*
"Confirm" implies that the assertion is right. I don't think it's the right term to use when asking a question.
As it is, I cannot confirm something that is wrong.

> Rémi wrote:
> My plays Flesh of Marble, then recieve 1 damage during the current round of combat.
> When they recieve more damage, is there a window to activate prevent effects before Flesh of Marble automaticly prevent all that damage.
>
I assume you mean you take a total of X damage at the same time (rather than 1, then later on, a new batch of damage).
When receiving damage, you can choose to prevent it or not. If you don't, the first damage is applied as usual, then the rest is automatically prevented by FoM.
Once FoM has kicked in, it's too late to play other means of prevention, since you cannot prevent damage that is already prevented.
